entities.summary: Cory Emmerton is a Canadian professional ice hockey coach for the Lausanne HC. He previously played as a centre in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Detroit Red Wings. Emmerton was drafted 41st overall by the Red Wings in the 2006 NHL Entry Draft.
